# Album Cover Maker

Album cover maker: square cover art for albums, EPs and singles, generated with the artist name and title, ready for Spotify and other streaming platforms.

## What it does
Give the artist, the title, the genre and the imagery. Claude tells you the price and creates square cover art.

**How the files are made:** each album cover is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Square image files; check your distributor's size rules.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install album-cover-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Album Cover Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/album-cover/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each album cover uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The album covers show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_album_cover_models` | Models for album covers with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_album_cover_cost` | Exact price of one album cover before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_album_cover` | Starts one album cover in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_album_cover` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Synthwave cover for 'Night Drive' by Neon Coast"
- "A lo-fi single cover with a cat on a windowsill, title 'Rainy Days'"
- "A minimal indie rock EP cover, title 'Static'"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the album cover (the artist, the title, the genre and the imagery) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
